# Research You do not immediately have access to every possible technology out of the gate: while you do know the general concept, you need some materials to solidify your theory.
Research Workbench is the first workstation you'll need.
Research Workbench stores your research and research points. Research points are used to unlock researches, and research unlocks recipes. Each research entry has different disciplines: you will need a corresponding type of research points to unlock the research of that discipline. To get research points, you will need a book to write your observations into.
In this book, you will find notes about the items you'll need to progress. Use a book on the requested item in order to consume that item and convert it into research points. You might need more than one item. Be careful - you will DESTROY the item you're using for research. If you need to submit a solution (like water), the container for it will also be destroyed. Having a higher research skill increases the amount of points you'll get. Research kit displays only the base values (aka the ones you get without any skill).
To deposit research points, simply use your research kit on the research workbench. Then, select the research you'd like to pursue, click "Research" to spend research points on it, then click "Print" to get a blueprint.
To use your blueprint, simply click it on the nearest workbench or lathe, which will add the recipe to that workstation.
